dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCR0486 handles self-pay insurance receipt file creation and editing.
evidence: COPY directives with .INC files typical of JMA ORCA
No EXEC CICS/SQL, indexed file SELECT with ASSIGN to symbolic names
CPCOMMONSHELL.INC, CPRECEDAT1.INC, HCM25V02.INC copybooks typical of ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - specifically monthly self-pay insurance receipt detail file creation and editing for the JMA ORCA medical billing system
purpose.summary: ORCR0486 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software suite that creates and edits monthly self-pay insurance (自費保険) receipt detail files. It reads indexed patient insurance and disease name files (RECE41, RECE43, RECE47), formats receipt data including disease names, comments, and point totals, and writes output for printing. The program handles multiple revisions of Japanese health insurance regulations.

notable_features: INDEXED file organization with SEQUENTIAL access
OCCURS tables for receipt storage (up to 99 receipts)
Large working storage with receipt comment editing (2400-byte fields)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
254 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
Multiple REPLACING clauses in COPY statements
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese EUC encoding, decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake in the visible text. The file is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical billing system. Revision history spans 2005-2011 indicating active production maintenance. No COMP-3 usage is notable for a Japanese business application.
